sin.name: scoped-read-around-scope
sin.description: A scoped repository reads straight from the connection, so the read skips the environment scope every one of its reads is given and sees every environment's rows.
sin.rule: A scoped repository reads through selected, selected_ids, counted or another read that passes the query through _scoped. A read meant to cross environments goes through selected_globally or with_project, which say so by their name.
